name: MindMap
description: MindMap turns outlines into interactive, collapsible mind maps inside Claude so you can ideate, diagram, and align on complex topics without context-switching. Paste notes or describe a topic and MindMap builds a visual map you can explore with pan/zoom and fullscreen. Click any node to get instant explanations, making learning, planning, and analysis faster and easier to digest.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MindMap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MindMap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mindmap-claude.keenethics-labs.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MindMap MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MindMap provides these MCP tools: render_mindmap.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MindMap?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MindMap in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
MindMap does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
MindMap is developed by Keenethics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
